x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
min_error = 2e9
ratio = x / y
numerator = 0
denominator = 1

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a = int(ratio * i + 0.4999)
    error = abs((a / i) - ratio)
    if error < min_error:
        min_error = error
        numerator = a
        denominator = i

print(f"{numerator}/{int(denominator)}")
